race.comment: RACEY CASEY (9) was in a different class last time, sitting just off the speed before letting down impressively for a 2.25-length win at Hamilton over 1400m. In form and will take beating again. THINKING SENSATION (7) showed good early speed and led into the straight before fading to finish eighth, beaten 7 lengths, over 1400m at Ballarat Synthetic. Will go forward and is expected to be in the finish. SHE'S STARGAZING (4) has won two of her first six starts and draws well for the return, which has her poised for a big run. INTERJECTION (1) has switched yards since finishing fifth two months ago over 1550m at Randwick Kensington and just needs luck from the wide gate to play a role.
